snippet.title: Einstein's Riddle Tutorial
snippet.description:
How to play an Einstein's Riddle Android game, also known as Zebra Puzzle, or Sherlock Holmes Puzzle.

Real Einstein's Riddle is available both on Android (Google Play) and iOS since 2013.

Download on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rottzgames.logic

Download on iOS:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/real-einsteins-riddle/id950326185?mt=8

Group to discuss strategies and solutions: https://www.facebook.com/groups/288035414684910/
